items.text: Greetings Brigadiers!

We’ve been deep in the trenches these past few weeks, working hard on stability and performance improvements for Endless runs. We’ve turned the codebase upside down and inside out, looking in all of the nooks and crannies for unnecessary memory and performance hogs. They have been routed, and the Realms - while still under constant attack from Flesh Crabs - are now ridden of some of the more persistent bugs.

We’re confident that we have solved many of the issues plaguing crashes in Endless runs. While we’re still finishing up the big update for next month (which will include more improvements for Endless), we were so hyped for this fix that we just had to put it live asap!
We’re excited to see the new limits you will be able to push the game in Endless. See y’all soon!
BOLT BLASTER OUT
Hi there! This is a quick one… We are working on a bigger update, which is planned for the end of the year, but we wanted to already drop some stuff for you to try out.

We added some additional spells that are unlocked from the start, essentially giving early players some more options already. We also wanted to expand on the Augmentations, giving older spells some new stuff as well. Players have been requesting more Augmentations forever, so we hope you’ll like ‘em! For the full list, check out the patch notes (spoiler warning):
[p align="justify"]✨ New Spell: Loaded Dice + 4 Augmentations: Roll giant dice across the field that explode with a force relative to the side they land on.
[p align="justify"]✨ New Spell: Tiny Tremors + 4 Augmentations: Trigger multiple mini earthquakes that scatter and crush anything within reach.
[p align="justify"]✨ New Spell: Wicked Buzzsaw + 4 Augmentations: Send out a large spinning blade that lunges towards targets.
[p align="justify"]💪 13 New Augmentations for older Spells:
[p align="justify"]Aura Beam (Aether Beam): Beams create a growing field of energy around their target that deals Damage to nearby enemies.
[p align="justify"]Baby Sprout (Vengeful Sprout): Whenever one of your Plants kills an enemy, there is a small chance a smaller Plant grows in that spot.
[p align="justify"]Chthonic Pull (Chthonic Charge): Charges pull enemies towards their center.
[p align="justify"]Counter Talon (Talon Slash): After taking Damage, your next cast has 2 additional Talons.
[p align="justify"]Massive Missile (Magic Missile): Your Missiles are significantly bigger and stronger, but they take longer to cast and are much slower.
[p align="justify"]Piercing Blades (Phantom Blades): Each Blade will pierce an additional target (stacks).
[p align="justify"]Pulling Whirl (Necro Whirl): Whirls pull enemies towards their center.
[p align="justify"]Scepter Link (Scepter Mesh): Scepters can connect to you, forming a damaging beam between you and the Scepter.
[p align="justify"]Solar Zenith (Solar Pulse): Your Pulse increases in Size and Damage while standing still (stacks).
[p align="justify"]Super Star (Falling Stars): Occasionally cast a much bigger Star that deals a lot of damage in a bigger area.
[p align="justify"]Unrung Bells (Bell March): Unrung Bells will always explode at the end of their lifetime, but the explosion will be smaller.
[p align="justify"]Waxing Moon (Moonerang): Moonerangs increase in Size over their lifetime (stacks).
[p align="justify"]Wing Split (Aurora Wings): Upon each hit, a Bird has the chance of splitting off a smaller Bird.
[p align="justify"]Improved sliding on Ice Patches by preventing additional external forces.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where killing the boss too fast in Endless Mode could break Level Ups.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed the timing of the music muffle during Level Ups.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where sometimes the sound muffling effect during a Level Up would not be applied.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed a racing condition during lobby creation that could prevent players from joining each other.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where the Scroll Hoarders could be pushed into obstacles and walls.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Exploding mushrooms now count towards collection challenges on clients.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where the Geysers in the Frozen Ancients would occasionally only do 1 damage.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed issue where the Broodmaw’s eggs could still damage players after spawning.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where sounds weren't fully muted when the SFX slider was set to 0.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where banning Scrolls after picking the Lucky Scroll would allow you to pick the same Scroll twice.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed the Plasma Infusion's burn damage being lower than intended and not looking at whether the initial hit crit.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed Flux, Glint and Shadowbolt Infusion's lightning bolt damage not scaling with crits in the initial hit.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Removed Healing Slam from the augmentations pool in solo play so it’s only available in co-op sessions.
🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback
As mentioned above, we’re working on a bigger update that will release soon! We cannot say anything yet but you won’t have to wait too long. Stay tuned!
BOLT BLASTER OUT
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/cc8557a2da40a4ce66e1f6a86d551f001628760f.png"]

We started work on this update well before the 1.0 release and continued production while working on all the patches that addressed the community’s feedback. We’re happy to say that The Spell Brigade post 1.0 is still very much on track! This first official update is just the tip of the iceberg!
To summarize, here’s what we’ve been up to since the 1.0 Release 4 months ago:
Patch 1 & 2 fixed the most common bugs and significantly rebalanced progression and cost scaling.
Patch 3 & 4 further stabilized 1.0 with some more bugfixes and performance improvements.
Patch 5 addressed the most common design criticisms like the grindy economy, Objectives and the Abstinence Covenant.
Patch 6 fixed some more bugs.
Patch 7 reworked the Wizard & Trial unlocking, improved our Devotion system, and also introduced Tiny Mode!
Patch 8 resolved some more issues.
Patch 9 introduced more community-inspired improvements, and 7 new Scrolls!
Patch 10 fixed the last high priority stuff, leaving room to prepare for Update 1.1!
We also added a brand new ROADMAP.
Update 1.1, which we’ll get to right now!

items.text: 🌎 Many, many, many map improvements
There’s simply too much to list here! Just head down to the patch notes already!
🎯 Objective Variants

[p align="justify"]After successfully completing an Objective once, you will unlock different versions that slightly change up the gameplay. Again, the patch notes summarize them very well. Here’s a little teaser:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/7b1e6026cbbaefdf10657e4c4d511c4f18590580.gif"]
🧙 An exotic new Wizard
[p align="justify"]Of course, it wouldn’t be a real Update without another addition to the roster of fine spellcasters.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/21b998d2f81bc5de9d5860ceccfeff1c631764b6.gif"]
Realm Sweep introduces the spectacular Eugenie, packing the smashing Seismic Slam Spell. There’s also some new cool Outfits to unlock. Did I mention we have patch notes?
[p align="justify"]🧙 New Wizard: Eugenie, including 3 new Outfits
[p align="justify"]✨ New Spell: Seismic Slam
[p align="justify"]🎩 5 new unlockable Outfits - one for Moon Mage, Kavin, Pipwick, Maggie, and Sun Mage
[p align="justify"]🎯 Objective Variants - each Objective can now appear in different forms:
[p align="justify"]Rifts can now appear as multiple, smaller ones across the map.
[p align="justify"]Sacrifice can now appear as a Death Shrine that takes damage from anything within the zone.
[p align="justify"]Mushrooms have a chance of either being scared or explosive.
[p align="justify"]New Golden Crabs can now appear: a Golden Crablodon, and a Golden Mothercrab that spawns a bunch of tiny Crabs.
[p align="justify"]New Statues can now appear that hold bigger enemies.
[p align="justify"]Bigger Spell Cores can now appear - these are much heavier and require more handling.
[p align="justify"]A darker type of Soul Sludge can now appear and cloud your vision when surrounded by it.
[p align="justify"]Mana Beasts have a chance of falling in love with you and will follow you unconditionally.
[p align="justify"]A new type of Brazier that generates a new sequence each time that you must copy.
[p align="justify"]🏆 10 new Quests
[p align="justify"]🌍 Map Improvements
[p align="justify"]Each Realm has been expanded with additional map variants that offer new level layouts, making each run a little more different.
[p align="justify"]Each map has some new visuals and props, some of which can be destroyed. Maybe they store something inside?
[p align="justify"]Roads in the Verdant Meadows have been reworked so the speed boost you get stays a little longer.
[p align="justify"]Frost Branch in the Frozen Ancients can now be trampled by walking over them multiple times. The more trampled they are, the less they slow you down.
[p align="justify"]Ice Patches in the Frozen Ancients have been reworked so they’re much more fun to traverse (just try it!).
[p align="justify"]Geysers in the Frozen Ancients will knock back enemies on the first hit, and also deal percentage-based Damage (to non-boss enemies).
[p align="justify"]Lava in the Pyrestorm Pit has been reworked to increase Damage with each tick, so quick Lava hops are less punishing.

[p align="justify"]Tornadoes in the Pyrestorm Pit can now be infused by elements! If an infused Spell hits a Tornado, they will inherit that element. They will also interact with all types of items, as well as Spell projectiles.
[p align="justify"]Rivers in the Astral Riftlands have been reworked so you can move against the current, allowing more player agency.

[p align="justify"]💭 In general, you should be more in control of how you interact with each of the map hazards and you will have more ways to interact with the map itself, allowing for each playthrough to feel more different from the last.
[p align="justify"]🤝 You now get your 3rd Spell at Level 13, and your 4th Spell at Level 20.
[p align="justify"]🤝 When getting a new Spell, you can immediately pick an Upgrade for it.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Additionally, your 3rd and 4th Spell will immediately upgrade to Level 3 and 4.

[p align="justify"]💭 Most players will unlock the Abstinence covenant and immediately go to playing with just one Spell. While we think this is mostly fine, and we don’t want to make this an unviable choice, we do want to ensure that the more chaotic and varied multi-spell playstyle is equally viable. The above changes move us closer to that goal and we will be closely monitoring how this change affects the balance.
[p align="justify"]✅ Improved frozen states and immunity phases for all Bosses, so all animations properly sync.
[p align="justify"]✅ Mul’gath’s healing minions can now be corrupted to deal Damage to Mul’gath upon collision.
[p align="justify"]✅ Mul’gath can now be properly corrupted, triggering new behavior.
[p align="justify"]✅ Rifts will now shrink the more you progress, becoming increasingly harder to fully close.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Reworked Ice and Dark Healing Spells so their negative effects no longer apply to teammates.
[p align="justify"]✅ Pickups like Scrolls and Mushrooms are now affected by Rivers.
[p align="justify"]✅ Improved the VFX of the Arcane Broadsword so they scale better with Size Upgrades.
[p align="justify"]✅ Improved some timings and animations for Mul’gath.
[p align="justify"]✅ Improved the visuals for the Rifts.
[p align="justify"]✅ Removed the additional level dots on Upgrade Cards if the Second Infusion has not been unlocked yet.
[p align="justify"]✅ Rebalanced various Exploding Augmentations to have similar impact across different Spells:
[p align="justify"]Swirl Sickle: reduced explosion radius from 3 to 2.5.
[p align="justify"]Scepter Mesh: increased damage multiplier from 1 to 2.
[p align="justify"]Magic Missile: reduced damage multiplier from 1 to 0.7.
[p align="justify"]Impish Havoc: increased damage multiplier from 1 to 1.5.

[p align="justify"]💭Exploding Augmentations could be one of the best or one of the worst Augmentations depending on which spells you equipped them to, because Spell Lifetime and Cast Speed would make its effectiveness vary wildly. With these changes the Augmentation should be closer to the average power of an Augmentation across spells.

[p align="justify"]✅ Reduced the Size Mastery’s multiplier slightly, but increased the chance to maintain power level.: 💭The previous version of the Size Mastery led to ugly visuals and some spells would very quickly start dealing unavoidable self damage. By lowering the multiplier this is negated somewhat, while increasing the chance to trigger it should keep its power level the same.
[p align="justify"]✅ Acid status duration gets reset upon hit instead of adding to it.
[p align="justify"]✅ Increased general Ice resistance for all Bosses.
[p align="justify"]🤝 The Game Over Sequence has been reworked/expanded:
[p align="justify"]UI/UX revamp
[p align="justify"]Additional Player & Spell Stats
[p align="justify"]New Team Stats Menu
[p align="justify"]Artifact info & stacks have been added to the Game Over stats (also in the Pause Menu).
[p align="justify"]Timed Gold/XP sequence that more clearly communicates the earned Gold and Wizard Rank XP after a Mission, as well as the applied bonuses.
[p align="justify"]🤝 You can now rotate your character in the Wizard and Outfit Menus.
[p align="justify"]✅ Added UI visualization for picking “Any” Realm or Threat Level in the Lobby.
[p align="justify"]✅ Added more run info to the HUD while in-game like your Threat Level, enabled Covenants and your Devotion.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Added a little popup near the Quit button in the Pause Menu that assures you you won’t lose progress.
[p align="justify"]✅ Implemented Steam Rich Presence, so you can see additional info from your friends playing The Spell Brigade in the Steam Overlay.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Menus in the Lobby can now be closed with the same key as opening them.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Personal Mission setup will now persist after leaving someone’s Lobby.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Ping Icons will now scale based on their distance to you.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Additionally, Ping Icons will now curve around relevant HUD elements so they’re always visible.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed a targeting priority issue where Seeking Augmentations would not always target the enemy with the most HP.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where the Scroll Hoarders would not properly show a healing effect when healed.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where Flying Mantas would constantly fly on top of each other while changing targets.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed a visual issue with the Spear Barrage popping out upon its despawn.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where Lava would not properly shrink or expand for clients.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed a rounding error in the Wizard Rank XP progress display.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed a visual issue where Grovewarden Aldric’s staff would cut off in the Wizard Menu.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed a visual issue where some of the Necro Whirl’s VFX would not fade out properly.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where Mul’gath’s Damage resistance would not function properly during phase transitions.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where clients could only get damaged by a Tornado once.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where all players would use Kavin’s laugh if one Kavin was in the team.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where Krog’wa would get stuck in a hole in the Astral Riftlands.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where scrollbar handles would disappear when dragging them.

[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where slowed animation speeds would go out of sync with movement speed when frozen.: 🤝 Fixed an issue where the Revive timer would continue progressing while Leveling Up or pausing the game.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where Spell Cores would lose their force when a player died while controlling it.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where Spell and Total Damage would not add up in the Game Over Menu.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where Spell projectiles would rotate unexpectedly after Level Ups.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where Spells would skip a target to avoid a teammate that was out of range.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where Offensive Defense would display a value of 0 instead of the actual one.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where Magician Collision would trigger on respawn.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where an enemy’s hit flash effect would not always trigger.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where the Solar Pulse’s visual would not properly reflect its actual radius.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where the Titles Menu would start at the bottom.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed multiple issues with the Ban/Lock buttons being selected at inappropriate times.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed multiple obstacle collision issues in the Verdant Meadows.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where players would not get all stats in the Game Over Menu after leaving a game.
🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback
💭 = design philosophy

We hope you’re as excited about all these improvements as we are! We’re currently working on some more stuff that will drop fairly soon, and we also have something extra special cooking that’s due for the end of this year. Stay tuned!
BOLT BLASTER OUT

items.text: [p align="justify"]Attention Brigadiers, fresh Patch coming up! It’s great to see that the last few patches have made a lot of our players happy, so we thank you all once again for your feedback and engagement! To summarize, last patch featured:
⚖️ Gold and Wizard Rank system rebalance
☝️ Abstinence Covenant
🎵 Old Soundtrack
🎯 Mana Beast Objective improvements
🪲 Many more bug fixes!
As promised, this new patch has some more changes and improvements that we hope you’ll enjoy:
🎯 Improvements for the Spell Cores and Soul Sludge Objectives
🧙 Quest-based Wizard unlocking (instead of Gold)
😈 Improved Trial progression and Devotion system
🤏 A new Trial: Diminution
✨ Spell & Enemy balancing/improvements
🙌 Much more!
Check out the patch notes below, and scroll down a bit further to see what we’re working on next.
[p align="justify"]😈 A new 8th Trial: Diminution
[p align="justify"]🤝 Wizards are now once again unlocked through completing Quests - any Wizards already unlocked remain unlocked, and any Gold spent on unlocking Wizards will be refunded!
[p align="justify"]🤝 Trials now simply unlock in order upon every Ascension, as opposed to Ascending a specific amount of times with a specific Wizard.
[p align="justify"]As a result, all the “Ascend once more” Quests have been absolved, and the Ascension Outfit Quests have been moved to the Outfit Quests.
[p align="justify"]As a result, the “Completionist” Quest has been changed to complete by unlocking 36 different Outfits.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Added new UI elements in both the Covenants and Game Over menus to explain more clearly what Devotion does and how much each Trial adds.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Improved the interactivity, physics and networking of the Spell Cores to make for more intuitive gameplay.
[p align="justify"]✅ Explosions, Resurrection Beams, Tornadoes and Void Hoppers can now also clear Soul Sludge.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Reworked the Talon Slash so it no longer divides its Damage over all targets.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed Talon Slash targeting issue where it would prioritize targets outside its range.
[p align="justify"]✅ Made it so the Spell Size Mastery also impacts the Talon Slash.
[p align="justify"]✅ Added maximum ranges to various Boss attacks, so they will be able to track players more consistently.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Changed the Out With A Bang achievement so it requires you to kill multiple enemies with Knelly’s Death Explosion instead of a Boss.
[p align="justify"]✅ Locking Improvements has been made less restrictive to increase player agency.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Added a visual indicator of the Bell March’s lifetime.
[p align="justify"]✅ Maggie’s trait has been improved to show individual Spell Cores, Statues and Mana Beasts earlier.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Statues will now receive a ping on their location at the end of the Objective, similar to the Spell Cores and Mana Beasts.
[p align="justify"]✅ Improved the visual effect of the Solar Pulse scaling due to the Spell Size Mastery.
[p align="justify"]✅ The Devotion visual in the lobby player seat has been given some animations for smoother transitions.
[p align="justify"]✅ Added a custom damage pop up that triggers when the player dies due to the Mortality Trial.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where the stat buttons in the pause menu would not highlight properly.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where the stat icons in the pause menu would overlap with text.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Devotion per Trial, and the linked amount of Gold and Wizard Rank XP increases have been slightly rebalanced.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Improved Gold cost scaling of Ascensions.
[p align="justify"]🤝 The following Spells have been buffed:
[p align="justify"]Spear Barrage -> Damage has been increased by 30% - more improvements are planned for the next patch!
[p align="justify"]Phantom Blades -> Damage has been increased by 10%.
[p align="justify"]Talon Slash -> Damage has been increased by 20%.
[p align="justify"]Impish Havoc -> Damage has been increased by 20%.
[p align="justify"]✅ All Elder Monsters have been given more Health, Move Speed, and Ice Resistance to make them more present. They have also been given specific changes:
[p align="justify"]Elder Shaman heals more targets for more Health, more frequently.
[p align="justify"]Elder Bloat Crab’s explosion radius has been increased, with a longer wind up.
[p align="justify"]Elder Teethy Worm moves significantly faster, but turns slower.
[p align="justify"]✅ Some early Title unlock conditions have been adjusted.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Implemented a way to refund Enchantments individually.
[p align="justify"]🤝 The game will now better restore lost Quest progress.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Matchmaking now prioritizes low latency lobbies.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed a rounding error in Spell Damage number tracking, resulting in mismatches between Damage popups and the numbers in the Stat Menu.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where the Move Speed Mastery would display an incorrect value in the Enchantments menu.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where the Critical Damage Mastery would count each spell cast, as opposed to each non-critical hit.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where Crit Bells were not impacted by the Spell Visibility setting.
[p align="justify"]✅ Fixed an issue where Mana Beasts would sometimes spawn inside the pen.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Improved reliability when connecting to Steam services.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Fixed an issue where a player could still join a lobby at the moment the game was starting, causing various issues.
🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback
We have one more 1.0 patch planned. In the meantime, we’re also working on some new content for the next few updates! We will share more info on that later. The next patch will have:
📜 Scroll balancing and improvements, as well as some new ones!
✨ More Spell balancing and improvements, including the infamous Damage issues with Splitting Augmentations
🛠️ Some performance and stability fixes
💅 Some more QOL improvements

Thank you all once again for sticking around, Brigadiers! We appreciate your passion and dedication to helping us make this silly wizard game the best it can be, and we hope you appreciate the work we’re doing.
BOLT BLASTER OUT
🤝 Fixed an issue where Mana Beasts that have been herded in their pen would bleat continuously.
🤝 Fixed an issue where Soul Sludge couldn't be cleaned after using a portal.
🤝 Adjusted old soundtrack volume to better match new soundtrack.
🤝 Fixed an issue where players with high latency could inadvertently prevent everyone from completing the Braziers Objective.
🤝 Fixed an issue where the Onslaught Trial description was missing.
🤝 Fixed an issue where you could not complete the A Worthy Sacrifice achievement as client.

Fellow Brigadiers, we have a new patch ready for you! We’ve been listening closely to you all since the 1.0 release and have been working non-stop to implement your feedback. This patch includes the improvements that we considered the highest priority and that we could address relatively quickly.
⚖️ Gold and Wizard Rank system rebalance
☝️ Abstinence Covenant
🎵 Old Soundtrack
🎯Mana Beast Objective improvements
🪲 Many more bug fixes!
Check out the patch notes below, and scroll down a bit further to see what we’re working on next.
[p align="justify"]🤝 PROGRESSION
Reduced Gold cost for Ascensions, also reduced XP needed to reach Max Rank.
Reduced Enchantment costs, as well as cost scaling.
Increased all Gold gain during Missions.
Added a 15% Gold bonus to Severe Missions.
Added a 30% Gold bonus to Hardcore Missions.
[p align="justify"]🤝 ABSTINENCE
[p align="justify"]Turned the Abstinence Trial into a Covenant and gave it a new Quest so it unlocks much sooner.
[p align="justify"]Anyone that already had Abstinence still has it.
🤝 MANA BEASTS
Added a second opening to the pen.
Improved spawning and wandering values.
Increased move speed when being herded.
Increased their size slightly.
[p align="justify"]Unfound Mana Beasts now get a pointer when the Objective is nearing its end.
[p align="justify"]Did the same for Spell Cores.
[p align="justify"]Added a unique ping icon to the Mana Beast pen so players can differentiate them better.
[p align="justify"]Did the same for the Spell Core zone.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Added a new visual effect for the Critical Chance Mastery.
[p align="justify"]✅ Updated the cleaning effect during the Soul Sludge objective.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Added a Soundtrack toggle so players can switch between old, new, and mixed.
[p align="justify"]🤝 Improved the Community button in the Start Menu so it no longer shows Discord or Bilibili based on language, but rather shows both choices to everyone.
🤝 Implemented a recovery system that restores Gold and Wizard Rank XP on crashes.
🤝 Fixed an issue where playing with 2 Denial Trial Stacks would only yield Spell Upgrades and no Stat Upgrades.
🤝 Fixed a missing translation for the Healing Tooltip.
🤝 Fixed an issue where corrupted enemies could still be damaged while having their life extended.
🤝 Fixed an issue where Pipwick could not cast Thunder through his random infusions.
🤝 Fixed an issue where activated Covenants would persist through a deleted save file.
🤝 Fixed an issue where Knelly’s death explosion would deal friendly fire with Harmony enabled.
🤝 Fixed an issue where Mana Beasts could leave the pen when already entered.
🤝 Fixed an issue where Archmage’s Blessing would appear again in the next Level Up after already being picked in the previous one.
🤝 Fixed an issue where the Size Mastery didn’t work on Bell March.
🤝 Fixed an issue where Star Mage couldn’t be revived when fighting Sol’phish.
🤝 Fixed an issue where locked Outfits could be shown/spoiled in the Wizard Menu.
🤝 Fixed an issue where save file recovery wouldn’t trigger after power outages.
🤝 Fixed an issue where banishing all Spell Upgrades except for Size, while having all Abstinence Stacks enabled, would result in no available Upgrades.
🤝 Fixed an issue where the blurry background in menus wasn’t rendering correctly.
🤝 Fixed an issue where the player could not access a Wizard’s Ascension menu through highlighting the Wizard.
🤝 Fixed an issue where the Perfect Synergy achievement would not unlock when playing as a client.
🤝 Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in the loading screen after a run, if the host disconnected at that time.
🤝 Fixed an issue where players could no longer collect Mana Orbs after respawning and immediately picking one up while having Hard Lessons equipped.
🤝 Fixed an issue where completing a Cycle in a Hardcore Endless mission would not count as completing that Realm.
🤝 Fixed multiple issues of challenges wrongfully incrementing progression when booting the game.
🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback
There’s still a lot more to address, so here’s an overview of the things we’re currently addressing. You can expect these changes in a few weeks probably:
🎯 Improvements for the Spell Cores and Soul Sludge Objectives
🧙 Quest-based Wizard unlocking (instead of Gold)
😈 Improved Trial progression and Devotion system, as well as a new 8th Trial to fill the gap left by Abstinence
✨ Spell & Scroll improvements
We have also created a public beta branch that we will regularly update with testable content. Your feedback now is more important than ever to us!

‘Tis the spooky season! And nothing is spookier to us than releasing yet another update within less than 30 days! The last update focused a lot on the new realm, the Astral Riftlands. But in the meantime we’ve been working on more content we’d love to share today!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/51b57dc0774c9418cad553c4364c32efcbb8e23f.gif"]
We’ve added 2 new spells to the game: Swirl Sickle and Spear Barrage. These spells are added to the pool of spells and can be selected just like any other in a run.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/959c7b01dca6e41ae44b8a2a2724c1a8b6ff4ee9.gif"]
This pretty lady has entered the battlefield! The Broodmaw is an elite enemy that will drop eggs that hatch after some time. Spoiler alert: you don’t want the eggs to hatch.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/67f9c359d1e1fed35e44ac84a4e5e3e9ddad8362.gif"]

A herd of Mana Beasts has escaped, and the Brigade needs them for their, well, mana. If encountered on a mission, the wizards will have to herd them to the nearest pen so they can be returned home safely.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/35da2750a03ec9d4bb19f123be65d61b2f880c74.gif"]

We’ve done a lot of improvements to the Dark element. More specifically, a lot of enemies have custom behavior when corrupted. Even the mighty Sol’phish and Krog’wa can now get corrupted, if your spells are strong enough.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/4b9a8d9be511af1242731afd1c0e3dbc21144831.gif"]
Bryony’s attempt at a secret mission to the forbidden Pumpkin Realm has backfired, and now they’re everywhere! We’ve added 4 pumpkin outfits that you can try to unlock (they’re pretty cool).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991302/76b3dc3b3c6030278ef99c15b497f9563722a10f.gif"]

[p align="justify"]We removed the update countdown! Aah! Before you start panicking - this is for a very valid reason! We’ve been cranking out updates for more than a year now. This spooky 13th update will be the last content update before we release our big 1.0 update.

[p align="justify"]When, you ask? All we can say for now is that you’ll know soon, and that 1.0 will not be the end for The Spell Brigade! So stay tuned! If you want more updates on what we’re working on, check out our Discord. We share stuff there every week. We’ve also updated the roadmap one more time, which should give you an idea of what’s still coming.
[p align="justify"]Now, onto the patch notes!

items.text: Brace yourselves, Update 10 has arrived! We've been hard at work on the game, trying to incorporate as much of your feedback as possible every step of the way. Therefore, we have been busy developing features for both this update and future updates. Nevertheless, this update has a lot of improvements, some reworks, and some new stuff as well. Catch the highlights below, or scroll down for the patch notes!

We’ve reworked the Revive System for multiplayer, so you’ll never sit on the sidelines again! Now, if you die, you become a ghost! As a ghost, you can wander around the map and still collect XP orbs to help your team level up. We’ve also improved much of the feedback so players will be quicker to respond to teammates in need of assistance.

This has been one of our most requested features, so we’re excited to share our new Stat Menus! Aside from your Player Stats, you can now also access the stats of each of your Spells, as well as view the Relics you collected. You can now also access your performance (kills, objectives, etc.) during the current mission at any time.

The Spell Brigade’s most recent addition to the roster is quite an ominous fellow. Balthazar stalks the mission fields with his melee-focused Talon Slash. He also specializes in Lifesteal and has the unique ability to revive teammates from beyond the grave.

As you know, we put a lot of effort into staying up-to-date on player feedback so we can always deliver on what our players want the most. That being said, being the small team that we are, some of this content, like new Worlds or Bosses, takes a long time to design, implement, and iterate on.

Needless to say, trying to find the right balance between short and long-term development has proved a bit of a challenge. Because we DO want to keep giving you new stuff to check out regularly, and some of these things just take longer than a month to get right.

So if you’re wondering where the promised new world and bosses are, there’s your answer. We’re working on them. Wizards and Spells are just easier to add within shorter releases. But do not worry, they are coming soon! To summarize, here’s a quick rundown of the bigger things we’re currently working on:
☠️ a new Boss
🌎 a new World
👻 new Enemies
🎯 new Objectives
🌐 Matchmaking improvements
🤝 Many more community requested improvements

0.7 is here! We know this one features some highly requested and anticipated features so let’s just get down to it immediately:
We've added 2 new enemies. Our questionable naming skills aside, behold...
THE SNEAKY BUG
Sneaky Bugs roam the Frozen Ancients, only running at you when your back’s turned to them (hence “sneaky”).
THE FLYING MANTA
Flying Mantas - get this - fly around the Pyrestorm Pit. They’ll draw on you quickly so beware! We’re also currently working on more Realm-specific enemies, but more on that later…

The highly requested Friendly Fire toggle and Endless Mode have both been implemented in the form of Modifiers, which we’re calling Covenants. When selecting your Realm and Threat Level, you can now also activate any of the available Covenants to modify the rules of your run.

Activate Harmony Pact to disable Friendly Fire, meaning you can’t hurt yourself or your teammates, and they can’t either. Activate Eternal Bond to enable Endless Mode, allowing you to keep playing after defeating Sol’phish, and starting a new cycle.

We plan to add more Covenants in the future, so we’re very excited to see what this brings to the game. Obviously, balancing an endless experience is very challenging, and we will be constantly improving this mode throughout Early Access to get it just right.

While these new features add a lot of value to the game, we quickly realized that this would also impact the matchmaking, as more choices for your run will also create more scattering of lobbies, making it potentially harder to match with the right players. And while our numbers are definitely growing, our player base is not THAT big to have many matches for each particular run choice.
That’s why we took some more time to not only improve the matchmaking process technically, but also give players some more options when trying to find players.

By accessing the Matchmaking Options, you can now choose to prioritize your own run choices, or match with players in any run setup. We also added a meter for “Wizard Activity”, which essentially gives you a rough estimate of how easily you can find other players.

items.text: The Spell Brigade is officially out now. We took a quick power nap and got right back into it, ready for more!

We’ve already gathered a bunch of suggestions and bug reports from everyone that played it on launch day, so a big thank you to you all for providing us with your constructive feedback🤝 The matchmaking had some issues that were quickly pointed out, so we’ve had a look and fixed some of the biggest problems already to provide you with a quick patch. You can check out the notes below:

You’ve probably spotted a cheeky little countdown in the Start Menu. That means that you can expect our first real update next week, featuring some more matchmaking fixes, quality-of-life improvements and maybe even some new stuff already🤫

Again, thank you everyone! We had a good launch, and all your kind words have given us enough energy for many more updates! If you haven’t already, please leave an honest review on our store page, as it helps us out greatly.
Stay tuned, enjoy the wizarding and see you soon. We’ll get back to work now🫡
